newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania says to seek more credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania says to seek more credit ratings.

text.p: Lithuanian Finance Minister Algimantas Krizhinauskas said on Thursday the country would seek more international debt ratings after Moody's awarded it a Ba2 for its foreign currency debt and Ba3 for its bank deposits.
"We have already seen the impact of the credit rating in reduced borrowing costs both domestically and internationally," Krizhinauskas told a news conference.
"Now we are seeking a rating this year from IBCA and probably next year from Standard and Poors," he added.
Lithuania has several times tapped the international markets for loans for its budget deficit.
"We expect that the rating will improve further," Krizhinauskas added.
Lithuania's image was badly hit by a banking crisis last year, but the country has gradually been recovering.
International investors have shown a fair appetite for Lithuanian paper.
U.S. investment house Merrill Lynch recently underwrote an issue of 200 million litas of domestic Treasury bills.
